title: hymenoxys argentea var. ivesiana
intro: Hymenoxys argentea var. ivesiana, commonly known as Ives' goldenrod, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ives' goldenrod include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
